Give callers a stable and diagnosable failure contract

Exception diagnostics verify that validation, dependency and unexpected failures are classified correctly, wrapped at the service boundary and preserve their original exception evidence.

The value of enforcing this family

Consumers can respond to meaningful service exceptions while operators retain the inner detail needed to diagnose the real cause.

Choose a diagnostic below for its Standard references, architectural rationale and practical bad and good code examples.
